name: Wealthfolio personal finance landing page by Wealthfolio
description: A warm off-white, editorial landing page pairs large high-contrast serif headlines with compact monospace supporting text and restrained black controls. The page starts with a spacious hero and layered desktop/mobile product mockup, then moves through denser feature cards, local-data diagrams, pricing, community proof, deployment options, add-ons, and a quiet final CTA; pale beige section shifts and thin rules provide rhythm without strong colour blocks.
